header: Steps to customize Copilot's guided response using your organization's guidebook
content:
your organization's guidebook
From the Copilot tasks pane inside an incident, go to Create tasks from your own
guidebook and select Open Copilot settings.
Then follow these steps:
1. Select Add new guidebook.
2. Select Upload file.
3. Browse to the file location, choose the file, and then select Generate.
4. After the file is uploaded, go to the Pending review tab.
5. The pending review tab shows the new recommendations based on the uploaded
guidebook. Review the file to ensure it meets your organization's standards. Select the
guidebook name and review the suggested generated tasks.
6. If the guidebook meets your standards, select Approve and activate to make it available
for use in guided responses. If it doesn't meet your standards, select Delete to remove it.
7. Make sure the guidebook appears as active in the Guidebooks tab. To deactivate it later,
select the guidebook and choose Deactivate.
Copilot will prioritize your organization's custom guidebooks over the default ones provided
by Microsoft. If multiple guidebooks are relevant, Copilot will use the one that best matches
the incident context.
You have the opportunity to provide feedback on the effectiveness of the guided responses
generated from your organization's guidebooks. This feedback helps improve future
recommendations.
For examples of Microsoft's own incident response playbooks, see Incident response
playbooks.
When creating your organization's guidebooks, keep in mind that the guidebook can only read
text. Avoid using images, graphs, or complex formatting that may hinder text extraction.
Last updated on 11/24/2025
